verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion capsule has a diameter of 16.5 feet.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states the heat shield of the Artemis 2 Orion capsule is 16.5 feet wide, which corresponds to the capsule's diameter.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion capsule has roughly 330 cubic feet of habitable living space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Orion’s cabin has a habitable volume of 330 cubic feet (R1); cabin of Orion is comprised of 330 habitable cubic feet (R2); interior space of 330 cubic feet (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state 330 cubic feet habitable volume for Orion.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion capsule stands 11 feet tall excluding the service module.
verifications.label: OMITTED
verifications.reasoning: No reference mentions the height or 11 feet for the Orion capsule.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion capsule has capacity for 4 crew members.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: four astronauts will fly inside the Orion spacecraft (R1); four astronauts on the Artemis II mission (R2); four astronauts on board (R3); carries four astronauts (R5)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm four crew members for Artemis II Orion.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II Orion capsule is roughly 60% larger than the Apollo command modules.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Orion has nearly 60 percent more space than the Apollo command module’s 210 cubic feet (R1, R2); nearly 60% larger than its Apollo command module predecessor (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state Orion is nearly 60% larger than Apollo command module.
